rescueSubtitle: Stay calm. Actions taken in the first 60 minutes matter most.
rescueOptOtp: Shared or entered an OTP / PIN
rescueStepBank: Call your bank or UPI app helpline immediately to freeze the account or dispute the transaction.
rescueStep1930: Call 1930 immediately or file a report at cybercrime.gov.in.
rescueStepEvidence: Keep screenshots of the message, the link, phone numbers, and transaction IDs (UTR).
rescueStepNoDelete: Do not delete the WhatsApp or SMS chat — police and bank teams need the evidence.
rescueStepFamily: Tell a trusted family member or village secretariat staff member right away.
rescueStepInstalledNote: If you installed an unknown app, ask 1930 or your nearest cyber police desk for safe phone-cleanup advice.

aboutPrivacyBody: Messages, screenshots, and voice notes you check are never stored on our server. Before any AI analysis, Aadhaar numbers, mobile numbers, account numbers, IFSC codes, UPI IDs, OTPs, and URL parameters are redacted. District Radar stores only the domain, scheme tag, action type, and district when you explicitly opt in.
aboutIndependentBody: Nijama? Mosama? is an independent public-interest tool and is not affiliated with any central or state government agency.
adminPublishRule: Publishing a registry entry as verified requires both a non-empty sourceUrl and verifiedOn date.
